class=\"language-js\">import { SchemaRenderer } from '@kne/form-creator';\n\n// 默认居中提交 / 重置\n&lt;SchemaRenderer schema={schema} formProps={{ onSubmit: console.log }} /&gt;\n\n// 完全自定义操作区\n&lt;SchemaRenderer schema={schema} actions={&lt;MyButtons /&gt;} /&gt;\n\n// 不显示操作按钮\n&lt;SchemaRenderer schema={schema} showActions={false} /&gt;\n// 或\n&lt;SchemaRenderer schema={schema} actions={false} /&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h4>SchemaRendererInner</h4>\n<p>只渲染 Schema 区块内容，<strong>不包外层 Form</strong>，便于放入业务已有 <code>Form</code> 内。操作区相关 props 与 <code>SchemaRenderer</code> 相同。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>schema</td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>表单 Schema</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>preview</td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>false</td>\n<td>预览态</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>className</td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>包在表单区块外层的 className（可选）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td>ReactNode</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>追加内容</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>showActions</td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>true</td>\n<td>是否展示提交/重置操作区（默认开启，可不传）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>actions / showSubmit / showReset / submitText / resetText / *ButtonProps</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>同 SchemaRenderer</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">import { SchemaRendererInner } from '@kne/form-creator';\nimport { Form, SubmitButton } from '@kne/form-info';\n\n&lt;Form onSubmit={console.log}&gt;\n  &lt;SchemaRendererInner schema={schema} /&gt;\n&lt;/Form&gt;\n\n// 不展示按钮区，自行放按钮\n&lt;Form onSubmit={console.log}&gt;\n  &lt;SchemaRendererInner schema={schema} showActions={false} /&gt;\n  &lt;SubmitButton&gt;提交&lt;/SubmitButton&gt;\n&lt;/Form&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Schema 结构</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">{\n  actions?: {\n    showSubmit?: boolean,   // 默认 true\n    showReset?: boolean,    // 默认 true\n    showCancel?: boolean,   // 默认 false（可选取消按钮）\n    submitText?: string,    // 空则用「提交」\n    resetText?: string,     // 空则用「重置」\n    cancelText?: string,    // 空则用「取消」\n    align?: 'center' | 'start' | 'end', // 默认 center\n    gap?: number,           // 按钮间距，默认 16\n    submitButtonProps?: object,\n    resetButtonProps?: object,\n    cancelButtonProps?: object\n  },\n  blocks: [{\n    id: string,\n    kind: 'formInfo' | 'list' | 'tableList' | 'multiField' | 'object' | 'choice' | 'steps',\n    title?, subtitle?, column?, gap?, bordered?, important?,\n    name?, label?, addText?, maxLength?, minLength?, fieldType?, autoStep?,\n    mode?, selectorName?, selectorInData?, discriminator?,\n    list?: [{ id, type, name, label, tips?, description?, rule?, block?, hidden?, props? }],\n    itemBlocks?: Block[], // list：列表项内子模块\n    blocks?: Block[], // formInfo / object：子模块\n    options?: [{ id, title, list?, blocks?: Block[] }], // choice\n    items?: [{ id, title, column, list: [...], blocks?: Block[] }] // steps 专用\n  }]\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><code>actions</code> 由 FormCreator 顶部「添加模块」旁的设置按钮弹窗配置，写入 Schema；<code>SchemaRenderer</code> 会读取并渲染居中操作按钮（组件 props 可覆盖 Schema）。</p>\n<h4>区块类型</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>kind</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>主要参数</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>formInfo</td>\n<td>表单信息区块</td>\n<td>title, subtitle, column, gap, bordered, list, <strong>blocks</strong></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>list</td>\n<td>动态列表</td>\n<td>name, title, important, bordered, maxLength, list, <strong>itemBlocks</strong></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>tableList</td>\n<td>表格列表</td>\n<td>name, title, bordered, maxLength, list（不支持子模块）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>对象分组</td>\n<td>name, title, column, gap, list（字段名渲染为 <code>name.field</code>）, <strong>blocks</strong></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>choice</td>\n<td>选项分支</td>\n<td>title, <strong>mode</strong>(<code>single</code>|<code>multiple</code>), <strong>minLength</strong> / <strong>maxLength</strong>（仅多选：最少/最多选几项）, selectorName, selectorInData, options[{ title, list, <strong>blocks</strong> }]</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>multiField</td>\n<td>同类型多值</td>\n<td>name, label, fieldType, addText（不支持子模块）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>steps</td>\n<td>步骤表单</td>\n<td>title, subtitle, bordered, autoStep, items[{ title, column, list, <strong>blocks</strong> }]</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><code>choice</code>：顶部同一条选项 UI；<code>single</code> 只挂载当前选项内容，<code>multiple</code> 平铺所有选中项。多选时可配置 <code>minLength</code> / <code>maxLength</code> 限制最少、最多选择几个（提交时校验；达到上限后未选项禁用）。JSON Schema 的 oneOf/anyOf 可分别映射为 <code>mode: 'single'/'multiple'</code>。<code>allOf</code> 无需独立 kind，展开为多个 sibling blocks 即可。</p>\n<p>兼容旧版：若仅有顶层 <code>list</code> 且无 <code>blocks</code>，会自动迁移为一个 <code>formInfo</code> 区块。</p>\n<h4>字段类型</h4>\n<p>基础：Input、TextArea、InputNumber、Switch、Checkbox、DatePicker<br>\n选择：Select、RadioGroup、CheckboxGroup、SuperSelect、SuperSelectPlus</p>\n<h4>工具方法</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><code>createBlock(kind)</code> / <code>createStep()</code> / <code>createChoiceOption()</code> / <code>normalizeSchema(schema)</code></li>\n<li><code>preset({ rules, fields })</code> 一次注册扩展规则与填写项（推荐）</li>\n<li><code>parseRuleString(rule)</code> / <code>buildRuleString(config)</code> 校验规则字符串解析/组装</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>preset（推荐）</h4>\n<p>应用入口调用一次，同时完成：</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>运行时校验</strong>：合并进 <code>@kne/react-form-antd</code> 的 <code>RULES</code></li>\n<li><strong>编辑器规则面板</strong>：写入「填写规则」勾选列表</li>\n<li><strong>扩展填写项</strong>：注册到字段类型 registry</li>\n</ol>\n<p>内置规则 <code>REQ</code> / <code>TEL</code> / <code>EMAIL</code> 已内置，无需重复配置；传入同名 key 可覆盖运行时规则并更新编辑器 label。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">import { preset } from '@kne/form-creator';\nimport { Rate, Slider } from '@kne/react-form-antd';\n\npreset({\n  rules: {\n    ID_CARD: {\n      label: '身份证格式',\n      reg: /^\\d{17}[\\dXx]$/,\n      message: '%s格式不正确'\n    },\n    RATE_MIN: {\n      label: '评分至少3星',\n      validator: value =&gt; ({\n        result: Number(value) &gt;= 3,\n        errMsg: Number(value) &gt;= 3 ? '' : '评分至少 3 星'\n      })\n    }\n  },\n  fields: {\n    Rate: {\n      label: '评分',\n      groupName: '评价组件',\n      component: Rate,\n      defaultProps: { count: 5 },\n      propsSchema: [\n        { name: 'count', label: '星星总数', type: 'number', min: 1, max: 10, defaultValue: 5 }\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n});\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>配置</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>rules</code></td>\n<td><code>Record&lt;string, RuleDef&gt;</code></td>\n<td>key 为规则 token；<code>RuleDef</code> 含 <code>label</code> + <code>reg/message</code> 或 <code>validator</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fields</code></td>\n<td><code>Record&lt;string, FieldDef&gt;</code></td>\n<td>key 为字段 type；见下方 FieldDef</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>FieldDef</strong> 常用字段：<code>label</code>、<code>component</code>、<code>groupName</code>、<code>defaultProps</code>、<code>propsSchema</code>、<code>hasOptions</code>、<code>hasFieldProps</code> 等。</p>\n<p>扩展填写项时，用 <code>fields</code> 内的 <code>propsSchema</code> 声明可编辑的额外参数（写入字段 <code>props</code>），编辑器会按声明自动生成「填写项设置」表单：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">fields: {\n  Slider: {\n    label: '滑块',\n    component: Slider,\n    defaultProps: { min: 0, max: 100, step: 1 },\n    propsSchema: [\n      { name: 'min', label: '最小值', type: 'number', defaultValue: 0 },\n      { name: 'max', label: '最大值', type: 'number', defaultValue: 100 },\n      { name: 'step', label: '步长', type: 'number', min: 0, defaultValue: 1 },\n      {\n        name: 'tooltipPlacement',\n        label: '提示位置',\n        type: 'select',\n        defaultValue: 'top',\n        options: [\n          { label: '上', value: 'top' },\n          { label: '下', value: 'bottom' }\n        ]\n      },\n      { name: 'dots', label: '显示刻度点', type: 'boolean' }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>扩展组件与校验（示例见「扩展组件与校验规则」）</h4>\n<p>使用 <code>preset({ rules, fields })</code> 即可，无需再单独调用 react-form-antd 的 <code>preset</code>。</p>\n<p><code>propsSchema</code> 项约定：</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>字段</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td>写入 <code>field.props</code> 的键名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td>编辑器展示名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>type</td>\n<td><code>string</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>select</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>placeholder</td>\n<td>输入提示（string/number/select）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>defaultValue</td>\n<td>缺省值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>min / max</td>\n<td><code>type=number</code> 时的范围</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>options</td>\n<td><code>type=select</code> 的选项 <code>{ label, value }[]</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>有 <code>propsSchema</code> 时会自动开启 <code>hasFieldProps</code>，无需再手写开关。</p>\n<p>&lt;!--START_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>组件</th>\n<th>简介</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><a     code: "const { SchemaRenderer, createBlock, createField, createChoiceOption } = _FormCreator;\nconst { default: JsonView } = _JsonView;\nconst { useState } = React;\nconst { Alert, Space, Switch } = antd;\n\nconst NestedChoiceExample = () => {\n  const [multiple, setMultiple] = useState(false);\n  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);\n\n  const schema = {\n    actions: {\n      showSubmit: true,\n      showReset: true,\n      submitText: '提交',\n      resetText: '重置'\n    },\n    blocks: [\n      createBlock('list', {\n        title: '教育经历',\n        name: 'education',\n        addText: '添加教育经历',\n        minLength: 1,\n        list: [\n          createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'schoolName', label: '学校', rule: 'REQ', props: { placeholder: '学校名称' } }),\n          createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'major', label: '专业', props: { placeholder: '专业' } })\n        ],\n        itemBlocks: [\n          createBlock('object', {\n            name: 'time',\n            title: '在校时间',\n            column: 2,\n            list: [\n              createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'startTime', label: '开始', props: { placeholder: '开始时间' } }),\n              createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'endTime', label: '结束', props: { placeholder: '结束时间' } })\n            ]\n          }),\n          createBlock('list', {\n            title: '课程',\n            name: 'courses',\n            addText: '添加课程',\n            list: [createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'courseName', label: '课程名', props: { placeholder: '课程名' } })]\n          })\n        ]\n      }),\n      createBlock('choice', {\n        title: '客户类型',\n        mode: multiple ?             column: 2,\n                list: [\n                  createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'companyName', label: '公司名', rule: 'REQ', props: { placeholder: '公司名称' } }),\n                  createField({ type: 'Input', name: 'creditCode', label: '信用代码', props: { placeholder: '统一社会信用代码' } })\n                ]\n              })\n            ]\n          }),\n          createChoiceOption({\n            id: 'person',\n            title: '个人',\n            blocks: [\n              createBlock('formInfo', {\n                title: '个人信息',\n                column: 2,\n description={<span>列表每一条里可以再放分组信息或子列表；选项切换可设为「只能选一个」或「可以选多个」（多选可限制最少/最多几项），下方会显示对应填写内容。</span>}\n      />\n      <Space>\n        <span>允许多选</span>\n        <Switch checked={multiple}     code: "const { default: FormCreator, preset, defaultSchema, createBlock, createField } = _FormCreator;\nconst { Rate, Slider } = _ReactFormAntd;\nconst { default: JsonView } = _JsonView;\nconst { useState } = React;\nconst { Alert, Typography, Space } = antd;\nconst { Text, Paragraph } = Typography;\n\n// 一次 preset：运行时校验 + 编辑器规则面板 + 扩展填写项\npreset({\n  rules: {\n    ID_CARD: {\n      label: '身份证格式',\n      reg: /^\\d{17}[\\dXx]$/,\n      message: '%s格式不正确'\n    },\n    RATE_MIN: {\n      label: '评分至少3星',\n      validator: value => {\n        const score = Number(value) || 0;\n        return {\n          result: score >= 3,\n          errMsg: score >= 3 ?        rule: 'REQ RATE_MIN',\n            description: '自定义 Rate 字段，规则要求至少 3 星',\n            props: { count: 5, allowHalf: false, allowClear: true }\n          }),\n          createField({\n    ]\n  }));\n\n  return (\n    <Space direction=\"vertical\" size={16} style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n      <Alert\n        type=\"info\"\n        showIcon\n        message=\"扩展方式\"\n 即可同时注册：运行时校验（@kne/react-form-antd）、编辑器「填写规则」勾选面板、扩展填写项类型。\n            </Paragraph>\n            <Paragraph style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>\n              规则项在 <Text code>rules</Text> 中写 <Text
